items.text: A work values and skills inventory for career choice is a structured list of what matters to you at work, what you can already do and what you enjoy, which you then test against real roles, so it becomes a decision aid and not a verdict.
List values, skills and interests separately, rate them honestly, test against ten real roles and discuss with a trusted person.
Treat results as prompts for conversations and never pay for a single definitive answer.
